notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for inherited object-attribute projection. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich model FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and object class and attribute names. It verifies that a derived object instance is discovered through both a base-class subscription and a derived-class subscription, that a base-only subscription receives only its inherited attribute from a multi-attribute update, and that the derived subscription receives inherited plus declared attributes with the ordinary delivery metadata. It does not assert provider-specific names, registries, headers, or fixture behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class hierarchy lookup, attribute publication and subscription, object registration, ordinary attribute update, and FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador inherited object-class attribute publication, subscription, and projection declarations
